description: This file implements the procedures for configuring a User Equipment (UE) in a 5G network, including handling RRC reconfiguration, DRB and SRB management, MAC reconfiguration, and handling handover procedures. It is part of a larger DU (Distributed Unit) software stack for 5G NR.

classes.name: ue_configuration_procedure
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the UE configuration process, including resource allocation, bearer setup, and reconfiguration procedures.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main procedure to handle UE configuration, including resource updates, bearer management, and MAC reconfiguration.

methods.name: stop_drbs_to_rem
methods.description: Asynchronous task to stop traffic on DRBs that are to be removed.

methods.name: update_ue_context
methods.description: Creates and updates UE SRB and DRB objects, and manages their connections.

methods.name: update_mac_and_sched
methods.description: Reconfigures MAC layer and scheduler for the UE based on the current configuration.

methods.name: make_ue_config_response
methods.description: Constructs a successful UE context update response including DRB setup/modification results.

methods.name: make_ue_config_failure
methods.description: Constructs a failure response for UE configuration.

methods.name: make_empty_ue_config_response
methods.description: Constructs a success response with no changes.

methods.name: changed_detected
methods.description: Checks if there are any configuration changes to process.

methods.name: handle_conditional_mobility_request
methods.description: Handles conditional mobility requests, such as handover triggers.

methods.name: handle_rrc_reconfiguration_complete_ind
methods.description: Handles the indication that RRC reconfiguration is complete, flushing buffers as needed.
